title: hoa.@process
description: `hoa.@process` is a properties manager for an enclosing `hoa.process~` instance, providing read-only information such as its index, parent order, processing mode/type, total instance count, and harmonic degree/order. It accepts property queries or settings and passes float, symbol, and list messages through; in harmonics mode, a bang outputs `@order`, `@hdegree`, and `@horder`.
